description: Source code for Git's bisect functionality, implementing commit bisection algorithms, reference management, and related utilities.

methods.name: count_distance
methods.description: Counts the distance in commits from a starting commit list, used for bisection heuristics.

methods.name: clear_distance
methods.description: Resets the COUNTED flag on commits in a list.

methods.name: weight
methods.description: Retrieves the weight (heuristic value) of a commit in the bisection process.

methods.name: weight_set
methods.description: Sets the weight (heuristic value) for a commit in the bisection process.

methods.name: count_interesting_parents
methods.description: Counts the number of interesting parent commits for a given commit.

methods.name: approx_halfway
methods.description: Determines if a commit is approximately halfway in the bisection process based on heuristic weight.

methods.name: show_list
methods.description: Displays a list of commits with their flags and weights for debugging.

methods.name: best_bisection
methods.description: Selects the best candidate commit for bisecting based on heuristic distance.

methods.name: compare_commit_dist
methods.description: Comparator for sorting commits by their distance heuristic.

methods.name: best_bisection_sorted
methods.description: Selects the best candidate commit for bisecting, returning a sorted list based on heuristic distance.

methods.name: do_find_bisection
methods.description: Performs the core heuristic to find the commit that best bisects the range of commits.

methods.name: find_bisection
methods.description: Main function to find the bisect commit from a list of commits.

methods.name: register_ref
methods.description: Registers references related to bisect, such as good, bad, and skipped revisions.

methods.name: read_bisect_refs
methods.description: Reads bisect-related references from the repository.

methods.name: read_bisect_paths
methods.description: Reads bisect path configurations from a file.

methods.name: join_oid_array_hex
methods.description: Joins an array of OIDs into a hex string separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: filter_skipped
methods.description: Filters out skipped commits based on the skipped revisions list.

methods.name: get_prn
methods.description: Pseudo-random number generator used for skipping commits.

methods.name: sqrti
methods.description: Calculates integer square root, used in random skipping.

methods.name: skip_away
methods.description: Skips commits randomly based on pseudo-random number generator.

methods.name: managed_skipped
methods.description: Manages skipped commits, filtering and skipping as needed.

methods.name: bisect_rev_setup
methods.description: Sets up revision list for bisecting, including bad and good commits.

methods.name: bisect_common
methods.description: Prepares revision walk for bisecting.

methods.name: error_if_skipped_commits
methods.description: Checks if only skipped commits remain and reports error if so.

methods.name: is_expected_rev
methods.description: Checks if a revision matches the expected revision for bisect.

methods.name: bisect_checkout
methods.description: Checks out a specific commit for bisect testing.

methods.name: get_commit_reference
methods.description: Retrieves a commit object from a repository given an OID.

methods.name: get_bad_and_good_commits
methods.description: Retrieves commit objects for bad and good revisions.

methods.name: handle_bad_merge_base
methods.description: Handles cases where the merge base is bad or unexpected.

methods.name: handle_skipped_merge_base
methods.description: Handles cases where the merge base must be skipped.

methods.name: check_merge_bases
methods.description: Checks merge bases for validity in bisecting.

methods.name: check_ancestors
methods.description: Verifies that revisions are ancestors of each other.

methods.name: check_good_are_ancestors_of_bad
methods.description: Ensures all good revisions are ancestors of the bad revision.

methods.name: show_commit
methods.description: Displays commit details to the user.

methods.name: read_bisect_terms
methods.description: Reads the terms used for bisecting (e.g., 'bad'/'good').

methods.name: bisect_next_all
methods.description: Performs the next step in the bisect process, selecting the next commit to test.

methods.name: estimate_bisect_steps
methods.description: Estimates the number of steps remaining in the bisect process.

methods.name: mark_for_removal
methods.description: Marks references for removal during cleanup.

methods.name: bisect_clean_state
methods.description: Cleans up bisect state, removing references and files.
